tema: Política de seguridad de la información
texto_norma: establishes a policy on information security setting out the overall principles of the organisation with regard to the potential impact of information security risks on aviation safety
consulta: information security policy overall principles aviation safety accountable manager

elementos.nombre: relación con la seguridad aérea (aviation safety)

texto_norma: The organisation shall document ... all key processes, procedures, roles and responsibilities ... and shall establish a process for amending that documentation.
consulta: document key processes procedures roles responsibilities ISMS manual ISMM amending documentation

texto_norma: a statement signed by the accountable manager confirming that the organisation will at all times work in accordance with this Annex and with the ISMM
consulta: information security management manual ISMM statement signed accountable manager

texto_norma: The organisation shall identify all its elements which could be exposed to information security risks ... activities, facilities and resources ... equipment, systems, data and information
consulta: identify elements exposed information security risks activities facilities resources services equipment systems data

tema: Identificación de interfaces con otras organizaciones
texto_norma: The organisation shall identify the interfaces that it has with other organisations, and which could result in the mutual exposure to information security risks.
consulta: identify interfaces other organisations mutual exposure
tema_en: Identification of interfaces with other organisations

texto_norma: assign a risk level according to a predefined classification ... The predefined classification ... shall take into account the potential of occurrence of the threat scenario and the severity of its safety consequences.
consulta: risk level predefined classification occurrence likelihood threat scenario severity safety consequences risk matrix

elementos.nombre: severidad de las consecuencias para la seguridad

tema: Revisión del análisis de riesgos ante cambios
texto_norma: The organisation shall review and update the risk assessment ... (1) change in the elements ... (2) change in the interfaces ... (3) change in the information or knowledge ... (4) lessons learnt from the analysis of information security incidents.
consulta: review update risk assessment change elements interfaces knowledge lessons learnt incidents

elementos.nombre_en: review and update of the assessment

tema_en: Review of the risk assessment upon changes

tema: Tratamiento de riesgos y eficacia continuada
texto_norma: The organisation shall develop measures to address unacceptable risks ..., implement them in a timely manner and check their continued effectiveness.
consulta: risk treatment measures unacceptable risks implement timely check continued effectiveness

texto_norma: The person referred to in point IS.I.OR.240(a) and (b) and other affected personnel ... shall be informed of the outcome of the risk assessment ... The organisation shall also inform organisations with which it has an interface ... of any risk shared between both organisations.
consulta: inform communicate outcome risk assessment threat scenarios measures personnel interfacing organisations shared risk
tema_en: Communication of the risk assessment outcome

texto_norma: The organisation shall establish an internal reporting scheme to enable the collection and evaluation of information security events ... identify ... incidents or vulnerabilities ... identify the causes
consulta: internal reporting scheme collect evaluate information security events incidents vulnerabilities causes

texto_norma: Any contracted organisation which may expose the organisation to information security risks ... shall be required to report information security events to the organisation ... using the procedures established in the specific contractual arrangements
consulta: contracted organisations suppliers report information security events contractual arrangements

tema: Plazo de notificación a la autoridad competente
texto_norma: a notification shall be submitted to the competent authority ... as soon as the condition has been known ... a report shall be submitted ... as soon as possible, but not exceeding 72 hours from the time the condition has been known to the organisation
consulta: report notify incidents competent authority design approval holder 72 hours notification

numericos.nombre: plazo del informe a la autoridad

tema_en: Reporting deadline to the competent authority

texto_norma: a follow-up report shall be submitted ... providing details of the actions the organisation has taken or intends to take to recover from the incident and the actions it intends to take to prevent similar information security incidents in the future
consulta: follow-up report recovery actions prevent similar incidents competent authority

texto_norma: Those detection measures shall enable the organisation to: (1) identify deviations from predetermined functional performance baselines; (2) trigger warnings to activate proper response measures
consulta: detect monitoring incidents vulnerabilities deviations functional performance baselines trigger warnings alerts

elementos.nombre: desviaciones respecto a una línea base
generar avisos que activen la respuesta

texto_norma: (1) initiate the reaction to the warnings ... by activating predefined resources and course of actions; (2) contain the spread of an attack ...; (3) control the failure mode of the affected elements
consulta: respond warnings activate predefined resources contain spread attack control failure mode

texto_norma: (1) remove the condition that caused the incident, or constrain it to a tolerable level; (2) reach a safe state of the affected elements ... within a recovery time previously defined by the organisation
consulta: recovery measures remove condition caused incident safe state affected elements recovery time restore

tema: Respuesta a hallazgos de la autoridad
texto_norma: (1) identify the root cause ... (2) define a corrective action plan; (3) demonstrate the correction ... (b) within the period agreed with the competent authority
consulta: findings notified competent authority root cause corrective action plan demonstrate correction period agreed
tema_en: Response to findings from the authority

texto_norma: the contracted activities comply with the requirements of this Regulation and the contracted organisation works under its oversight ... the competent authority can have access upon request to the contracted organisation
consulta: contracting outsourcing ISMS activities external providers oversight comply competent authority access

elementos.nombre: el contratista trabaja bajo supervisión de la organización
elementos.nombre_en: contractor works under the organisation's oversight

elementos.nombre: cumplimiento de Part-IS por el contratista
acceso de la autoridad al contratista

tema: Aprobación previa de cambios en el ISMS
texto_norma: the application shall be submitted before any such change takes place ... the change shall be implemented only upon receipt of a formal approval by the competent authority
consulta: changes ISMS approval competent authority before change implemented procedure notified

texto_norma: The records referred to point (1)(iii), (iv) and (v) shall be retained at least for a period of 5 years. ... stored using means to ensure integrity, authenticity and authorised access.
consulta: records logs incidents risks archived traceable retained retention years integrity authenticity

tema: Retención de registros de cualificación del personal
texto_norma: The personnel's qualification and experience records shall be retained for as long as the person works for the organisation, and for at least 3 years after the person has left the organisation.
consulta: personnel staff qualification experience records retained years after leaving

texto_norma: The accountable manager shall appoint a person or group of persons ... That person or group of persons shall report directly to the accountable manager ... It shall be determined in the procedures who deputises for a particular person in the case of lengthy absence
consulta: appoint person responsible compliance information security officer report directly accountable manager deputy absence

elementos.nombre_en: reports directly to the accountable manager

texto_norma: (g) ... a process in place to ensure that the personnel ... have the necessary competence ... (h) ... acknowledge the responsibilities ... (i) ... identity and trustworthiness of the personnel who have access to information systems
consulta: personnel competence training acknowledge responsibilities identity trustworthiness access information systems

texto_norma: The organisation shall assess, using adequate performance indicators, the effectiveness and maturity of the ISMS. That assessment shall be carried out on a calendar basis predefined by the organisation or following an information security incident.
consulta: continuous improvement assess effectiveness maturity ISMS performance indicators calendar incident

elementos.nombre_en: predefined calendar or after an incident
